topic: Longitudinal dynamic stability, lateral dynamic stability
syllabus_extract: Longitudinal dynamic stability, lateral dynamic stability.
specific_objectives: 6.1.4.1 Trainee will be able to describe aircraft stability in all the three axis.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of static stability concepts; Instructor supervision required for theoretical verification.
intro_questions: List the three axes of aircraft motion.
Explain the role of the horizontal stabilizer in pitch.

development.content:
Definition of Longitudinal Dynamic Stability
Phugoid Oscillation characteristics
Short Period Oscillation characteristics
Damping effects in pitch motion
Stability criteria for longitudinal modes

Definition of Lateral Dynamic Stability
Dutch Roll Oscillation characteristics
Roll subsidence characteristics
Spiral mode stability analysis
Coupling effects in lateral motion

topics: Comparison of Static vs Dynamic Stability
Importance of damping in flight control
development.content:
Comparison of Static vs Dynamic Stability
Importance of damping in flight control
Summary of stability axes
Review of oscillation modes
Preparation for directional stability

summary_questions: Differentiate between phugoid and short period oscillations.
Identify the primary oscillation mode associated with lateral dynamic stability.
Explain why damping is critical for dynamic stability.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the concepts of longitudinal and lateral dynamic stability discussed in this lesson will assist in understanding directional static stability and propeller effects covered in LP 29.

pft_rows.syllabus: Directional static stability, prop effects, damping in Yaw, directional control, Effect of wing sweep back, spin, lateral dynamic stability.
